text:
Priya: Heads up — thinking about changing how Console applies route-level filters when you open a per-model view. Right now filters inherit and we show a small badge, but quotas and telemetry get confusing. 
Dylan: Yeah I noticed quota numbers jump when I toggle model scope. Should the API do an explicit scope param instead of implicit inherit? :thinking: 
Eva: Prefer explicit. Implicit inheritance leads to accidental cross-route usage. Also telemetry gets attributed to the route not the model when inherited. 
Sam: If we add ?scope=route|model we need backward compatibility for saved queries. Lots of saved queries expect current behavior. 
Priya: Proposal: new param scope plus a migration flag on saved queries. Behaviour: saved queries without flag keep old inherit; new queries default to explicit model scope. 
Dylan: How about we surface a migration CTA in the UI with a bulk opt-in for teams? Also need API doc snippet. 
Priya: Draft API snippet:
```http
GET /api/console/insights?route_id=rt_123&model_id=mdl_456&scope=model&include_saved=true
```
Dylan: For quota calculation must pass the effective_scope in telemetry events: {"effective_scope":"model"}. Otherwise backend routing still charges route bucket. 
ConsoleBot: saved_query.update: 5 queries migrated by migration-runner (info). 
Eva: Ops question — if scope=model and route fallback triggers (model unavailable), should we auto-fallback to route scope or return a 207 with partial results? 
Sam: Prefer auto-fallback with telemetry tag fallback_reason=fallback_model_unavailable. App teams can opt-out. 
Priya: Ok action items: 
- Dylan: add scope param to API and telemetry payloads (ETA 2d)
- Sam: bulk migration UI copy + opt-in modal (ETA 1w)
- Eva: decide fallthrough semantics + add fallback_reason tags (ETA 3d)
Dylan: I'll open a PR for the API contract and include sample events. 
Priya: Thanks — we'll sync in the triage meeting tomorrow. :rocket:
